scripts.build:worker: cd ../../crates/gproxy-host-edge && CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP=none worker-build --release && node ../../scripts/strip-wasm-debug.mjs build/index_bg.wasm && rm -rf ../../deploy/cloudflare/build && cp -R build ../../deploy/cloudflare/build
scripts.build:assets: pnpm --dir ../../console build && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp -R ../../console/dist public/console && node ../../console/scripts/prepare-edge-fonts.mjs public/console/index.html && cp public/console/index.html public/index.html && cp public/console/robots.txt public/robots.txt && cp _headers public/_headers
scripts.build: pnpm run build:worker && pnpm run build:assets
